XL01.en: The dying Taizong emperor lying on a low couch inside a rain-darkened mountain retreat at Cuiweigong, a single oil lamp guttering beside him, a young crown prince kneeling at the bedside, two elderly ministers in dark court robes standing over them with hands outstretched, cold wet dawn light through open lattice shutters, water dripping from the eaves outside

XL02.en: The young Gaozong emperor alone on a high dragon throne in a vast empty audience hall, the two elderly ministers's outstretched hands still hanging in the dark behind him, a single candle flame between them, his face half lit and half swallowed by shadow, deep blue night

XL03.en: Tang heavy cavalry fording a shallow river on the western frontier beyond the Pamir ranges, banners and lance tips breaking the water line, and in a second view a Tang war fleet crowding a coastal strait with smoke rising beyond the shore, bright even daylight

XL04.en: A Tang army encamped beneath the walls of a northern Korean city at dusk, siege engines and rows of tents spreading to the horizon behind attacking infantry, low orange sun cut by dust and smoke

XL05.en: The elderly statesman Zhangsun Wuji standing at the head of a row of courtiers in the Hall of State Affairs, one hand raised mid-argument, clan genealogies and bronze ancestral tablets stacked on a table behind him, lamplight burning off polished bronze, the other officials in shadow

XL06.en: Chang'an city at night under arrest: black-armoured guards forcing open the gate of a princely mansion, lanterns swinging in the wind, a bound royal prince being dragged down the steps in nightclothes, rain-slick stone

XL07.en: Inside the Taijihall the young emperor on his knees pleading with hands clasped toward a standing chancellor, tears on his face, and the chancellor turning half away with his sleeve pulled back, officials lining the columns watching in silence, red firelight from braziers

XL08.en: A bound kneeling prince on the flagstones of a palace forecourt at dawn, head raised to the grey sky, mouth open in a last cry, imperial guards standing off at a distance with their backs turned, officials in court robes watching from a raised terrace, thin mist over the stone, cold colourless morning light

XL09.en: A single young emperor sitting upright on the floor of an empty bedchamber all night long, the last candle burned down to a pool of wax, robes still on the floor where he dropped them, moonlight through a window on his unblinking eyes, deep night

XL10.en: The empress Wang and the favourite consort Xiao in an inner palace garden pavilion, ladies-in-waiting holding fans and parasols, painted screens and a stone basin of lotus, the two women's eyes locked with nothing said, harsh even midday light

XL11.en: A young nun in coarse grey-black robes walking out through the gate of the seminary Ganyesi, a mountain temple behind her in thin mist, a closed palace gate far off in the opposite direction, her face turned back over one shoulder, cold clean dawn

XL12.en: The emperor Gaozong and the new favourite Wu meeting in a dim corridor of the palace, a eunuch's shadow at the far end, neither of them looking at the other, a lit lamp on the floor between them, deep night with one warm light source

XL13.en: A palace nursery at dead of night: a small empty infant cot with a blanket still pressed where a body lay, the mother standing motionless in the middle of the room with her back to the door, a single lamp burning low on the dressing table, everything else in darkness

XL14.en: A court openly split: on one side the empress's clan officials with set faces, on the other a knot of low-ranking officials whispering behind a pillar, court attendants frozen where they stand, firelight from torches making the columns loom

XL15.en: A low-ranking official in worn robes kneeling alone at night in front of a closed palace gate, pounding the gate ring with both hands, his memorial scroll clutched under one arm, gate guards looking down from the walkway, black sky above

XL16.en: Three men in a dim back room sealing an alliance: the emperor half in shadow, the new empress-to-be with her hands folded in her sleeves, and a callow clerk bowing between them, a single lamp and three cups on a low table, cold morning light

XL17.en: The great audience hall of Taijidian in late autumn: withered grass blown across the stone steps outside, and inside, four old ministers standing in a row before the throne while the emperor sits with scrolls at his feet, cold wind lifting the curtains, pale overcast light

XL18.en: The grey-haired minister Chu Suiliang standing forward inside the hall holding a white ivory hu tablet level across both hands, arguing with his head up, the emperor seated behind a desk dragging a hand down his face, long shadows on the tiled floor, hard light from the doorway

XL19.en: Two imperial guards in black armour supporting an elder minister out through the great doorway of an audience hall, the minister's robes and hairpin disordered, the emperor seated far inside the hall with one hand over his eyes, courtiers shrinking back against the pillars, torchlight and deep shadows

XL20.en: The aging general Li Ji summoned in secret to a night chamber: a short bowed man in plain travel robes stepping forward while four ministers behind a screen argue among themselves, a brazier glowing low, deep night

XL21.en: The old general slowly setting down a tea cup on a low table, looking levelly up at the emperor, a personal seal and a mounted general's baton resting untouched on a lacquered tray between them, one warm lamp, everything else dark

XL22.en: A terrace at dusk: three figures moving away from the still water of a canal, a general with his hands behind him walking into mist, two young retainers waiting at the canal bridge, the imperial city wall with its corner towers very far behind, low red sun

XL23.en: A sealed imperial decree tablet on a lacquer tray held by a eunuch in a torch-lit corridor, a Deposed Lady's empty seat and an untouched cup on the floor beside it, guards blocking the corridor mouth, torchlight and hard shadows

XL24.en: A marshy southern borderland with rain falling for days: a brigand's road through wet bamboo, a small courier station in jungle behind a stockade, mist and standing water, the whole landscape the colour of ash and green rot, a single lamp burning inside the station

XL25.en: The Council of State in uproar: an official in green robes kneeling on the floor with a scroll open in his hands, the emperor standing with a sleeve over his eyes, a brush and a blank edict spread on the desk, officials' faces turned away, torchfire from floor braziers

XL26.en: A mountain post station deep in the Qianzhou ranges: a staircase in a dilapidated inn building, a black-armoured captain standing at the top, and below, a grey-haired old man with restored hairpin and straight ceremonial robes sitting in front of a guttering oil lamp looking at a long coiled white silk rope on the table before him, forested crags black beyond the window, deep forest gloom with one lamp

XL27.en: The emperor Gaozong and the new empress Wu standing side by side at a balustrade at dusk looking out over the palace roofs, her silhouetted thin body and long sleeves slightly in front of him, the capital spreading far below, his face in profile and hers in shadow, the low sun going down

XL01b1.en: A close view of the elderly minister Zhangsun Wuji receiving the dying emperor's last instruction, one hand held between the crown prince's, the rain-darkened mountain window behind them, lamp flame low

XL01b2.en: The young crown prince kneeling alone at the bedside after the others have gone, the dead emperor's couch in shadow behind him, a dropped imperial seal on the floor, rain still running down the shutters

XL02b1.en: The young emperor on the dragon throne with the seat's carved dragon arms seeming to close around him, two elderly ministers standing motionless in the dark behind, the hall emptying, deep blue night and one candle

XL09b1.en: A single emperor sitting upright on the floor of an empty bedchamber at first grey dawn, candle burned to wax, robes on the floor behind him, one hand pressed open on the tatami, the window going pale

XL10b1.en: The favourite consort Xiao in the pavilion with a young prince at her knee while the empress watches from the doorway, painted screens half drawn, stone basin and broken lotus stem in the foreground, harsh even midday light

XL13b1.en: The empress-to-be standing alone at a palace window with her back to an untouched breakfast tray, hair still dressed, hands clasped hard enough to show the knuckles, a sealed edict tablet on the table beside her, deep night

XL15b1.en: A worn-robes official climbing the steps of a palace gate in the dark with a memorial scroll held high over his head, glares lit by torches above, guards' halberds at the top, black night and hard firelight

XL16b1.en: Three officials sealing a private agreement in a dim back room: a stunned clerk still bowing at the door, the emperor half turned away, and a court lady standing at a screen with her hands folded in her sleeves, a single lamp and three cups on the table, cold morning light

XL17b1.en: Four elderly ministers standing in a row before an empty dragon throne inside a great hall while the emperor enters from a side door carrying a scroll, curtains lifting in cold wind, withered grass beyond the doorway, pale overcast

XL18b1.en: The grey-haired minister Chu Suiliang with both hands on an ivory tablet at his chest, arguing head up inside the hall, long shadows on the tiled floor, and the emperor's hand closing on a desk corner, hard light from the doorway

XL19b1.en: The great audience hall at the moment after: an empty space where the old minister knelt, a dropped ivory tablet on the stone, every courtier's head turned away, torch brackets flaring along the pillars

XL21b1.en: A close view of the old general's hands lowering an empty tea cup onto a lacquered table, a mounted general's baton and a personal seal lying untouched on a tray beside it, the young emperor visible as a blurred shape beyond the lamp flame, everything else dark

XL22b1.en: The young emperor standing at a moonlit palace balustrade in late autumn, a single attendant holding a lantern several paces behind him, cold clear moonlight striking the water of a canal below the terrace, a bare scholar's rock and a dropped fan on the balustrade, empty corridors leading off into dark, his face turned away from the light

XL24b1.en: A courier station in a wet southern jungle: a writing desk against a lattice window, an inkstone and unfinished memorial scroll, rain pouring off the thatch into standing water outside, everything green and grey

XL25b1.en: The emperor alone at an audience desk with a brush laid across a blank edict, a kneeling minister's scroll open at his feet, officials' sleeves withdrawing out of frame, torchfire from floor braziers

XL26b1.en: A black-armoured captain and three guards stopping at the door of a mountain inn building, a lacquer tray carried between two of them, the whole party standing still in the half-dark, forested crags beyond the veranda

XL26b2.en: The old man in restored ceremonial robes standing up alone in the attic room, letting go of the window shutter, an oil lamp burning beside him, the guttering light catching his hairpin and the folds of his sleeves, very deep forest gloom

XL27b1.en: A lone emperor standing at a balustrade at dusk with the palace roofs and a canal far below him, his back to camera, sleeves lifting in the wind, the red sun low behind the western wall towers
